title: Road Trip: A Novel
description: New from the beloved New York Times bestselling author of Summers at the Saint and Hello, Summer! Pack your bags for a summer journey shaped by family secrets, long-buried history, and charming men with Irish accents. Maeve and Therese Dunigan haven’t spoken in years. Raised under the same roof in Savannah, the two sisters could not be more opposite—Maeve the rule follower, Therese the unapologetic rebel. But when their mother’s death pulls them back together, they inherit more than just grief: a mysterious painting that may be worth millions…if it’s real. Determined to uncover the truth—and desperately in need of the money—the sisters set out on a journey to Ireland, tracing their family’s roots and the origins of the portrait. What begins as a search for answers soon becomes something deeper—a reckoning with the past, as they uncover secrets that span generations and reshape everything they thought they knew about their family. With tensions simmering, the two hit the road and find themselves on twisty lanes, in colorful villages, at local pubs, and with handsome men whose gift of the gab is surpassed only by their charm. Can Maeve and Therese actually survive the journey without killing each other? Join Mary Kay Andrews on a road trip that will entertain you for miles.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8"]', '#CardInstance9PspJc_t4jBZ4pXOAh9-Zg')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-eff

title: The Road Trip
description: Two exes reach a new level of awkward when forced to take a road trip together in this endearing and humorous novel by the author of the international bestseller The Flatshare. What if the end of the road is just the beginning? Four years ago, Dylan and Addie fell in love under the Provence sun. Wealthy Oxford student Dylan was staying at his friend Cherry’s enormous French villa; wild child Addie was spending her summer as the on-site caretaker. Two years ago, their relationship officially ended. They haven’t spoken since. Today, Dylan’s and Addie’s lives collide again. It’s the day before Cherry’s wedding, and Addie and Dylan crash cars at the start of the journey there. The car Dylan was driving is wrecked, and the wedding is in rural Scotland—he’ll never get there on time by public transport. So, along with Dylan’s best friend, Addie’s sister, and a random guy on Facebook who needed a ride, they squeeze into a space-challenged Mini and set off across Britain. Cramped into the same space, Dylan and Addie are forced to confront the choices they made that tore them apart—and ask themselves whether that final decision was the right one after all.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2"]', '#CardInstanceUFWxk_V9j7yRN_BcxVj_BQ')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_2',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal

title: Road Trip: A Baby Blues Collection
description: Buckle up for another hilarious year with the MacPherson family! This Baby Blues collection includes all of the 2024 daily and Sunday comic strips by award-winning duo Rick Kirkman and Jerry Scott. The family that vacations together stays together—assuming everyone survives the drive. In Road Trip , the 42nd Baby Blues collection, Rick Kirkman and Jerry Scott return to the MacPherson household for another round of wonderfully familiar parental chaos. Darryl and Wanda are still raising Zoe, Hammie, and Wren, which means every ordinary task has the potential to become a full-scale logistical emergency. And then there is summer. The MacPhersons debate whether to take a family vacation in the first place, while the kids demonstrate why “lifelong memories” may involve arguing in whatever vehicle gets them there. From inflatable backyard pools and water-balloon fights to summer reading, yard sales, shopping excursions, and the looming return to school, Kirkman and Scott find humor in the way parents dream of creating magical childhood experiences while children remain resolutely committed to behaving like children. Mixing black-and-white daily strips with full-color Sunday comics, Road Trip is a warm, fast-paced collection for parents, grandparents, longtime Baby Blues readers, and anyone who has ever discovered that family life is funniest about five minutes after the crisis is over. The popular Baby Blues comic strip series captures the ups and downs of family life with a perfect blend of humor and heart With alternating classic black-and-white newspaper-strip pages and larger full-color Sunday features, this is an especially satisfying collection for longtime fans or new readers. title: Route 66 The Complete Road Trip Guide: To America's Most Legendary Highway
description: Experience the magic of Route 66 on one unforgettable journey, whether you are traveling the entire Mother Road or only have a few days to explore. Have you dreamed of experiencing the golden age of the American road trip but felt overwhelmed by outdated guides, confusing detours, and endless planning? Do you want to discover the authentic diners, glowing neon motels, quirky roadside attractions, historic landmarks, and hidden gems that made Route 66 legendary? This guide brings it all together in one place, so you can spend less time planning and more time enjoying the road. Route 66: The Road That Built America is your invitation to rediscover the freedom, adventure, history, and nostalgia of America’s most legendary highway. Whether you are a first-time traveler, a lifelong road trip enthusiast, or simply looking for an unforgettable American adventure, this guide gives you the practical information and inspiration you need to travel Route 66 with confidence. Inside you’ll discover: State-by-state navigation and easy-to-follow maps - Travel Route 66 one segment at a time with clear guidance designed to help you navigate confusing city sections, original alignments, bypasses, and detours. Hidden gems worth the stop - Discover offbeat attractions, family-owned businesses, historic sites, unusual roadside stops, and local treasures that many travelers overlook. Flexible itineraries for every schedule - Choose from thoughtfully planned 2-, 5-, 7-, and 14-day itineraries, along with highlights for travelers who want to experience the best of Route 66 in less time. Local legends and fascinating stories - Go beyond the highway with stories from business owners, historians, and longtime travelers who help bring the Mother Road to life. title: Road Trip
description: One secret gay crush. One journey of self discovery. One epic road trip. Matt Landers and Jacob Mercer have been ride or die best friends forever. But now, on the cusp of adulthood, it’s all about to change. When summer is over, Jacob is going away to college and Matt will be stuck in Cape Charles, Virginia. Before that happens, they’ve got a plan for one more epic adventure—a road trip all the way across the country to California. But if they want to borrow Jacob’s dad’s car, there are rules they have to follow. Keep your location tracking on. Check your tire pressure. Be back a week before school starts. Don’t spend your college money. Check in every 24 hours. There’s nothing in the rules about arguing over road trip playlists, eating too many gas station snacks, or sleeping in the back of the car. There’s also nothing about confessing your secret gay crush, falling for your best friend, and learning how to protect the heart of someone you love. Summer might be short, but the things Matt and Jacob are going to learn about themselves will last a lifetime.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8"]', '#CardInstanceQLx9zFtOgaM4XuNIlNwnRg')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_8',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24

title: Road Trip USA: A Budget Road Trip Guide Across America
description: Road Trip USA: A Budget Road Trip Guide Across America 20 Days • 2,850 Miles • One Unforgettable Adventure — Without Breaking the Bank If you’ve ever dreamed of crossing America by car but felt overwhelmed by the cost, the planning, or the logistics, this book is your new travel companion. Road Trip USA: A Budget Road Trip Guide Across America is a practical, inspiring, and deeply researched guide built for real travelers — families, college crews, seasoned explorers, and anyone craving the freedom of the open road without the fear of overspending-A complete, stress‑free, budget‑friendly plan. This isn’t a glossy fantasy. It’s a real, doable, budget‑friendly coast‑to‑coast itinerary created by a Chicago‑based insurance professional who traveled the country with her family and learned firsthand how to stretch every dollar while maximizing every mile. Whether you’re planning your first road trip or your tenth, this guide gives you everything you need to make it unforgettable. 🌎 What Makes This Road Trip Guide Different? Most travel books assume unlimited budgets, luxury hotels, and expensive attractions. This one doesn’t. This book is built around a simple truth: “The open road doesn’t care how much money is in your account. It only cares that you show up.” Inside, you’ll find a 20‑day, coast‑to‑coast route from New York City to Los Angeles — designed entirely around free attractions , low‑cost meals , affordable lodging , and smart planning . Itinerary includes: Free or low‑cost things to do (free national monuments, free museums, low‑cost parks) Budget‑friendly food picks (Vegetarian & vegan options) Realistic daily budgets Lodging suggestions (hostels, campgrounds, budget motels) Driving distances & Car maintenance checklist Family, college, and senior‑specific advice

title: Road Trip (Road Trip Series)
description: A summer adventure you'll never forget, from a beloved Newbery Honor winning author! Dad and Ben haven't been getting along lately, and Dad hopes a road trip to rescue a border collie will help them reconnect. But Ben is on to Dad's scheme, and he's got ideas of his own. Like inviting his buddy, Theo, who's sure to get into fun (and trouble) along the way. And if Dad wants a family road trip, then the family dog, Atticus, should get to come, too. What could go wrong? But when their truck breaks down, the family trip takes plenty of unexpected turns. Before they know it, they've commandeered an old school bus and joined forces with its cranky mechanic, Gus. Next, they pick up Mia, a waitress escaping a tense situation. Only sharp-eyed Atticus realizes that Theo is on the run from something bad—and someone is following them. title: Road Trips in the USA: 50 Adventures on the Open Road
description: Hit the open road with 50 epic drives promising the all-American adventure Whether you’ve always dreamed of skirting the US on a motorcycle, are looking to go coast-to-coast in an RV or simply want to roll down your car windows and plug into a classic playlist, Road Trips in the USA will give you all the inspiration you need for a road trip to remember. Featuring 50 once-in-a-lifetime drives, Road Trips in the USA is a celebration of riding the open road. Turn the pages to discover: 50 driving routes ranging from a few hours, such as the scenic Hana Highway, to week-long trips like the iconic Route 66 Inspirational maps pinpointing all the key stops to make en route, such as classic landmarks and historic restaurants Practical information for each trip, including start and end stops, duration, distance, and road conditions Beautiful photography capturing the highlights of every drive Twist through Glacier National Park on the dramatic Going-to-the-Sun Road, leaf-peep along the Blue Ridge Parkway and enjoy the ocean breeze on the Pacific Coast Highway – with Road Trips in the USA , taking the scenic route has never been easier.
